name: Redland City Council current and upcoming tenders
status: Official current, upcoming and awarded tender surface
best_for: Local works, services, consultancy, infrastructure, facilities and Council-led opportunities that may touch Minjerribah.
watch_action: Check open tenders, upcoming tenders and strategic contracting notes before assuming there is no local opportunity.

name: Doing business with Redland City Council
status: Supplier guidance and VendorPanel routing
best_for: Understanding how Council releases, receives, evaluates and awards outsourced opportunities.
watch_action: Register supplier details and categories where appropriate; keep evidence and insurance current.

name: Redland City Council VendorPanel Marketplace
status: Marketplace and quote invitation pathway
best_for: Smaller goods and services opportunities where Council buyers invite quotes through supplier categories.
watch_action: Set category matches carefully so relevant local suppliers can be found.

name: Find Queensland Government tenders
status: Official guide to current and future Queensland procurement opportunities
best_for: State tender discovery across QTenders, eTender and forward procurement schedules.
watch_action: Use this as the first explainer, then check the named portal or pipeline directly.

name: QTenders
status: Queensland public tenders directory
best_for: Open, closed and awarded Queensland Government public tenders.
watch_action: Search for Minjerribah, North Stradbroke Island, Redland, ferry, tourism, ranger, environment, resilience and digital terms.

name: Queensland Government Supplier Portal
status: VendorPanel supplier portal for Queensland and local government opportunities
best_for: Supplier registration and broader tender discovery through VendorPanel.
watch_action: Keep supplier profile, categories and contact details current.

name: Queensland Procurement Policy 2026
status: Current overarching Queensland procurement policy from 1 January 2026
best_for: Understanding value-for-Queensland, sustainability, local benefit and strategic procurement expectations.
watch_action: Use policy language carefully when shaping value, local benefit and supplier capability statements.

name: Queensland Government Supplier Code of Conduct 2026
status: Current supplier conduct standard applying across Queensland Government procurement
best_for: Self-assessing legal compliance, ethical conduct, workplace practices, human rights, environment, conflicts and supply-chain behaviour.
watch_action: Build the evidence before giving the tender warranty; keep corrective actions and non-compliance reporting under control.

name: Procurement Assurance Model supplier guidance
status: Supplier evidence and assurance requirements from 1 January 2026
best_for: Preparing Code evidence and flowing purposeful-procurement commitments into subcontracts.
watch_action: Keep compliance evidence ready for assessment, investigation and contract reporting.

name: Queensland Government building prequalification
status: PQC contractor and consultant qualification system
best_for: Checking whether a government building contract or consultancy needs PQC category, level, licence and financial-capacity approval.
watch_action: Resolve the required prequalification before choosing the lead contractor.

name: TMR civil infrastructure prequalification and registration
status: Infrastructure Project Delivery System contractor and specialist schemes
best_for: Road, bridge, asphalt and specialist transport-infrastructure work.
watch_action: Match the package to the required TMR or National Prequalification class before forming the delivery team.

name: Dunwich (Gumpi) Ferry Terminal Upgrade
status: $41 million SEQ City Deal commitment in planning
best_for: Tracking the business case, design, likely work packages and future procurement preparation.
watch_action: Do not call it an open tender. Track the project page, QTenders, forward pipeline and industry briefings.

name: AusTender
status: Central Australian Government procurement publication portal
best_for: Federal approaches to market, planned procurements, standing offers and contract notices.
watch_action: Register, save searches and check the live Approach to Market details before responding.

name: AusTender current Approaches to Market
status: Current federal tender list
best_for: Requests for tender, quote, expression of interest, information and proposal.
watch_action: Search current ATMs for local-place keywords plus service categories such as health, digital, environment, tourism and resilience.

name: Selling to the Australian Government
status: Plain-English supplier guidance
best_for: Understanding open tender, limited tender and how buyers approach the market.
watch_action: Use this before drafting if the tender language feels confusing.

name: Commonwealth Procurement Rules
status: Current rules effective 17 November 2025
best_for: Understanding value for money, Australian business participation, procurement methods, thresholds and accountable decision-making.
watch_action: Read the current rules with the live approach to market; do not rely on an old threshold table.

name: Commonwealth Supplier Code of Conduct
status: Supplier conduct obligations used with Commonwealth forms of contract
best_for: Building evidence for ethics, conflicts, governance, tax, WHS, rights, environment, security, records and subcontractors.
watch_action: Map each applicable obligation to an owner, record and corrective-action process.

name: Commonwealth procurement-connected policies
status: Current policy trigger table
best_for: Checking Indigenous participation, tax records, payment times, gender equality, skills, environmental plans and Australian industry participation.
watch_action: Run the triggers against value, category, workforce, delivery location and the exact tender pack.

name: Commonwealth definition of an Australian business
status: Current ownership, tax-residence and principal-place-of-business definition
best_for: Proving Australian business status under the Commonwealth Procurement Rules.
watch_action: Keep ownership, tax residence and principal-place-of-business evidence ready.

name: Commonwealth Indigenous Procurement Policy
status: Current Mandatory Set Aside, participation and eligible-business policy
best_for: Checking Indigenous business eligibility, set-aside procurement and mandatory participation requirements.
watch_action: Use the current eligibility definition and live tender rules; ownership and control must be real.

name: Queensland Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander economic participation
status: Queensland First Nations business and enterprise development context
best_for: State context for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander business participation in procurement.
watch_action: Pair procurement readiness with real business capability, governance and cultural authority.

name: Minjerribah Futures
status: Official transition and cultural eco-tourism context
best_for: Understanding state-backed economic transition context after sand mining.
watch_action: Use as place context only; check tender portals for actual procurement opportunities.

name: Quandamooka Yoolooburrabee Aboriginal Corporation
status: Registered Prescribed Body Corporate for recognised Native Title rights and interests
best_for: Cultural authority context, partnership awareness and permission-sensitive project thinking.
watch_action: Do not treat this as a tender portal. Use it to remember that Country, culture and authority are not optional details.

name: Minjerribah Protected Area Expansion Strategy
status: Protected area and joint stewardship context
best_for: Environment, conservation, tourism, infrastructure and permission-aware planning context.
watch_action: Flag environmental and protected-area constraints before tendering for works or services.
